description: This Python source file contains utility functions for parsing and manipulating markdown and code blocks within documentation files, including handling headers, links, code includes, and comments, with support for localization adjustments.

classes.name: CodeIncludeInfo
classes.description: TypedDict representing a line containing a code include.

classes.name: HTMLLinkAttribute
